name: Eye of the Ancestors
text: Whenever an enemy unit destroys one of your LEAGUES OF VOTANN units, it gains a Judgement token (at most 2). Attacks by models with this ability add 1 to the hit roll against a unit holding a token, and also add 1 to the wound roll against a unit holding two.

name: Eye of the Ancestors (wound)
text: Attacks by models with this ability add 1 to the wound roll against a unit holding two Judgement tokens.

name: Grim Efficiency
text: Once per battle round, in your Command phase, pick one enemy unit visible to this model. It gains a Judgement token (at most 2).

name: Patrol Squads
text: When you declare battle formations, before any unit is set up, this unit may be split into two units of five models each. Each half keeps all of its abilities.

name: Medipack
text: While the medipack bearer is alive, every model in his unit (an attached leader included) has a 6+ Feel No Pain save.

name: Pan-Spectral Scanner
text: While the scanner bearer is alive, ranged weapons carried by models in his unit gain [IGNORES COVER].

name: Outflanking Mag-Riders
text: When the opponent's turn ends (not their first), if this unit has a model within 6 inches of a battlefield edge and is not in Engagement Range of an enemy, you may take it off the board into Reserves. Next Reinforcements step, set it up wholly within 6 inches of a battlefield edge that is not the opponent's, more than 9 inches from every enemy.

name: Cyberstimms
text: Each time a model in this unit is destroyed by a melee attack before the unit has fought this phase, roll a D6. On a 4+ it is not removed yet: it fights once after the attacking unit finishes, then is removed.
